subject: prd/tech-design-brainstorm
statement: When the session's design question opens or replaces a seam — a new interface, port, document class, or module boundary — the skill shall run the panel move: parallel design alternatives under orthogonal constraints, each recorded with its trade-offs and its score against the architecture principles and matched incidents; when the question purely extends an existing seam, the skill shall skip the panel; in both cases the record shall note which path was taken and why.
rationale: first-idea anchoring is strongest on novel seams; ceremony on extensions burns budget; the audit note keeps the call challengeable (#D-4)
fit_criterion: seam-rule fixtures: new-seam fires (≥ 2 genuinely distinct alternatives, each scored), extension skips, and 100% of sessions carry the audit note (EVAL-6)
